captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a simple, parametric hand chisel. It features a long, rectangular handle block with a square cross-section, transitioning into a flat, wedged cutting tip. The tip tapers symmetrically from the sides to form a sharp, straight horizontal edge at the very front.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric, 3D-printable chisel in OpenSCAD. The design should feature a rectangular handle and a tapered wedge tip, with customizable parameters for the handle length, handle width, handle height, tip length, and a minimum printing step height for the sharp edge.
captions.factory: The script uses a union of two main parts. First, a centered cube primitive defines the main handle of length L, height h, and width w. Second, a hull operation creates the tapered chisel tip, stretching from a thin slice cube at the front of the handle to an extremely thin, rotated cube at the very tip, controlled by the minimum printing step height parameter 'a' and tip length 't'.
